title: Operation Highjump

tellings.quote: So in 1946, for whatever reason, we United States Navy sent a huge expedition of ships to Antarctica.

plain: In 1946 the United States Navy sent a huge expedition of ships to Antarctica, an effort known as Operation Highjump and linked to the explorer Richard Byrd. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells it on the show without naming a source, saying the Navy did it "for whatever reason". He raises it because, if the purpose was not what was said, the trip may have been about something hidden in the far south.
